solution:
out = open('spamconf.txt', 'w')
out.write('From: sara@x.com\n')
out.write('X-DSPAM-Confidence: 0.8475\n')
out.write('Subject: hello\n')
out.write('X-DSPAM-Confidence: 0.6178\n')
out.close()
fhand = open('spamconf.txt')
total = 0
count = 0
for line in fhand:
    line = line.rstrip()
    if not line.startswith('X-DSPAM-Confidence:'):
        continue
    pos = line.find(':')
    piece = line[pos + 2:]
    try:
        value = float(piece)
    except:
        print('Cannot parse:', piece)
        continue
    total = total + value
    count = count + 1
fhand.close()
print('count:', count)
print('average:', round(total / count, 5))

tests.code: assert count == 2, 'expected: 2 | actual: %r' % count
assert abs(total - 1.4653) < 0.0001, 'expected: 1.4653 | actual: %r' % total

name.en: The labeled count and average are printed

tests.code: assert 'count: 2' in __learner_output__ and 'average: 0.73265' in __learner_output__, ('expected: count: 2, average: 0.73265 | actual: %r' % __learner_output__)

solution:
notes = ['note one\n', 'files in memory\n', 'note three\n', 'files again\n']
out = open('notebook.txt', 'w')
for note in notes:
    out.write(note)
out.close()
fhand = None
try:
    fhand = open('notebook.txt')
except:
    print('File cannot be opened: notebook.txt')
if fhand is not None:
    lines = 0
    chars = 0
    hits = 0
    for line in fhand:
        lines = lines + 1
        chars = chars + len(line)
        if 'files' in line:
            hits = hits + 1
    fhand.close()
    print('lines: %d' % lines)
    print('chars: %d' % chars)
    print('keyword hits: %d' % hits)

tests.code: assert lines == 4, 'expected: 4 | actual: %r' % lines
assert chars == 48, 'expected: 48 | actual: %r' % chars
assert hits == 2, 'expected: 2 | actual: %r' % hits
